rows.text: the Registrar of Companies **approves its renaming to ICICI Life Insurance Limited** with effect from 22 September, with a fresh certificate of incorporation issued; an application to IRDAI follows.

the **Additional Commissioner (Mumbai Central) dismisses its GST appeal, upholding a demand of Rs 3,75,29,796** — tax of Rs 1,87,64,898 plus an equal penalty — for July 2017 to September 2019. The company will appeal further.
discloses an order passed against it dated 21 August.

meta.co: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited
